priceSnapshot.note: Up +0.064% since yesterday's endday close (84,491.6 -> 84,545.8). 24h change +0.64% (open24h 84,011.5). Quiet Sunday-early-morning COT session, thin volume.

reduceIf.confirmation: Unchanged since the Sep-24 flush -- untested for an 8th straight session. A settled 1H close below 82,874.5 would end the hold and signal the recovery has failed. Session low since endday (84,304.3) stayed well clear.

addIf.confirmation: Unchanged since Sep-25 morning -- still capped by the 85,258.8 wick. A settled 1H close above 84,944.4 would confirm the range top is breaking. Session high since endday (84,650) pressed a little closer but stayed under it.

decisionBox.changed: No technical level change: reduceIf (82,874.5) and addIf (84,944.4) both carry forward untouched, now unbroken for an 8th straight session. What DID change: executed a discretionary partial profit-take on the spot core (sold ~35% of the BTC stack) rather than a pure mark-only hold. Reason: cash was down to 13.05 USDT with the Oct-1 30 USDT cost-of-living charge four sessions away -- savings (2.47) plus that cash would not have covered it, and the ledger does not floor cash at zero on a normal expense charge (only bankruptcy checks savings+equity), so doing nothing risked printing a negative cash balance on the 1st. The DCA lots were sitting +3.2% (avg entry 81,881.73 vs 84,545.8), and short-term momentum, while still range-bound, is only tentatively re-building (15m MACD hist flipped back positive, but 4H hist is still negative and daily RSI is pushing 64) -- a reasonable point to bank part of the gain and rebuild liquidity rather than wait for the expense to force the issue. Two-thirds of the core position stays on for the still-bullish daily trend structure.

These are already-swept shorts (forced buys that already happened as price pushed through here), so it marks recent friction more than untested resting liquidity ahead.
